latestVersion.changelog:
Ezviz Restaurant Inspection v1.0.0 released

- Initial release with automated camera image capture and AI-powered analysis for restaurant/kitchen inspections.
- Supports detection of hygiene issues, unattended open flame, trash bin status, goods storage, and mask compliance.
- Simple CLI usage with single/multiple device support and customizable prompts.
- Automatic token acquisition for secure operation; no manual token setup required.
- Data is transmitted only to official Ezviz endpoints; no third-party sharing.
- Designed for use in kitchens, dining areas, canteens, and multi-chain restaurant management.
